'''Carnuss Gorgull''' was a complex of ruins on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] in the depths of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] forests, with [[temple]]s and [[statuary]] dominating much of the area. It was used as a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course.
